title: How to pack for a graduate school
text:
Graduate School is a significant step in one's career. The transition from a rather free-living and fun-filled life experience as an undergraduate to a highly independent and self-caring position is an important transition. As such, when accepted by a graduate school for your higher studies, one of the first things one has to do in this transition process is to pack for your journey.

 Resources 
* Packing List by Vivek Rai
* Foreign Internship Packing List
